title: Root task export reports IO instead of the documented no_parent when the destination parent is missing; decide refusal precedence
outcome: Root task export reports IO instead of the documented no_parent when the destination parent is missing; decide refusal precedence
acceptance: Decide and document refusal precedence for export destinations with no lexical parent versus a parent missing or inaccessible on disk, using the actual absolute-path and existing-destination validation order; any behavior change is explicit.
A deterministic repository-contained regression pins the chosen behavior while ordinary-parent exports and no-clobber safeguards remain enforced.
